 Canal+ lines up K-drama series for Poland
 Lovely Runner will air on Canal+ Seriale in Poland
 NEWS BRIEF: Warsaw-based pay TV company Canal+ Polska has acquired a package of South Korean drama series produced by companies including CJ ENM, Studio Dragon, SBS and KT Studio Genie, after a deal with Canal+ Distribution.
 The deal includes K-dramas Lovely Runner (CJ ENM), True Beauty (Studio Dragon/Studio N), The Scarecrow (KT Studio Genie) and the SBS/Studio S productions Taxi Driver, Doctor Romantic and The Penthouse, which will all screen via the Polish content portal of Canal+. True Beauty and Lovely Runner will also be broadcast on the linear channel Canal+ Seriale in Poland.
